name: Luka Evans
title: The Haughty Lord
nickname: The Haughty Lord; "the landless lord" (behind his back)

origin.birthplace: Evans Hall, the ancestral estate in the northern valleys
origin.socialStatus: A titled nobleman with little land left and many debts
origin.profession: Lord and courtier; once influential at court, now almost without influence

appearance.face: Sharp aquiline nose, thin lips, chin always slightly raised; a fencing scar on the left cheekbone
appearance.hairAndEyes: Dark blond hair combed carefully back; short trimmed beard; cold grey eyes
appearance.clothing: An expensive but worn burgundy velvet jacket; a signet ring with the family crest; gloves he takes off only to gamble
appearance.build: Tall, lean, stands straight as if at a court reception
appearance.gestures: Taps his ring on the table while he waits; looks others up and down; tosses coins instead of placing them
appearance.voice: High, crisp voice; speaks slowly as if dictating; often interrupts
appearance.firstImpression: An arrogant man who expects everyone to stand when he enters
appearance.artistNotes: The jacket is patched on the inside — it only shows when he sits. The crest on the ring is half worn away. When he loses, his hands shake, but he hides them under the table.

backstory.biography: Luka is heir to an old family with vast lands. For years he lived beyond his means: balls, horses, gifts for the right people at court. When his influence waned the creditors came all at once, and he sold land after land to keep up appearances. Today he has a title, a half-empty manor and many debts, yet he still behaves like a man the world owes respect.
backstory.whyHere: He believes one great win could buy back his lands and his place at court. And he cannot refuse a game where people will be watching.
backstory.secret: That he is almost ruined and everything he stakes is borrowed.

psychology.secondTrait: An aggressive need to dominate in public
psychology.weakness: Cannot bear losing in front of an audience, and then stakes far too much
psychology.fear: Public humiliation — that people learn he is poor
psychology.desire: To win back his lands and his place at court
psychology.angers: Being ignored, contradicted by commoners, or laughed at
psychology.regret: That he squandered the family inheritance — though he would never admit it
psychology.moralLimits: Never openly breaks the rules of honour before witnesses. In private he rarely stops at anything
psychology.neverWould: Beg a commoner for help in public
psychology.wouldForReward: Break his word, and sell even the family ring

behavior.stakes: Big, showy stakes. Raises to scare the others
behavior.deception: A tool he accepts — but he hates being deceived
behavior.debts: Has many and hides them. Borrows easily, repays reluctantly
behavior.alliances: Temporary, and only with people of the "right" standing
behavior.whenAttacks: When he has an audience or someone has insulted him
behavior.whenRetreats: Almost never willingly. Only if a loss threatens to reveal he is poor
behavior.onLoss: Grows more aggressive and doubles the stake (tilt)
behavior.onWin: Boasts loudly and humiliates the loser
behavior.strategyChange: Only the threat of his secret coming out

motives.publicGoal: To show who is the strongest at the table
motives.hiddenGoal: To win enough to buy back his lands
motives.betrayalTrigger: If someone threatens to reveal that he is poor
motives.helpTrigger: If someone defends him publicly and preserves his dignity

speech.register: Correct, formal, bookish. Full of titles
speech.howLies: Confidently and haughtily, but with too many details
speech.angerAndFear: Raises his voice and taps the ring. When afraid he becomes far too polite

mechanics.strangeness: The crest on his ring sometimes shows another house — the one he pawned his lands to. Only he never notices.
mechanics.principle: Beg a commoner for help in public
mechanics.temptation: Cannot bear losing in front of an audience, and then stakes far too much
mechanics.ability: Old money: once per evening his payments to the host stay hidden at dawn.
mechanics.hostRelation: Debt — he has already borrowed from the host and pretends he has not.

authorNotes.distinctive: Arrogance plus secret poverty. The more he loses, the harder he pretends not to care.
authorNotes.immutable: The aggressive style, the pride, the secret poverty.
authorNotes.tunable: How strongly he reacts to mockery and how fast he tilts.

lines.text: Sit down, friends. Or at least those of you who know how.
The account is… temporarily unbalanced. One more round.
How dare you? Do you know who you are speaking to?
An alliance? With you? Well, I suppose even noblemen need servants sometimes.
You will regret this. House Evans remembers.
I double. Let us see who has the nerve.
Lord Luka Evans. His blood is blue, his pride bluer still. Do not ask him about his lands.
You again. Well — commoners are persistent.
House Evans… does not… end like this.

tells.description: Taps his ring on the table
Overdoes the details when he lies
Tosses coins instead of placing them

relations.story: Luka sat at the court that condemned Noah Thorn for Ashford — and voted "guilty".
relations.effect: They argue before the first round; both start with +20 Tilt.
